run_staleness_test: run the staleness test to check if generated files match their targets
fix_stale_files: run the staleness test with --fix to overwrite missing or out-of-date files

review_CheckFilesMatch: review the CheckFilesMatch function that compares generated files against target files
review_Config: review the Config class that parses file lists and extracts target, package, and pattern
